subject: COLLATING SEQUENCE clause
notes: Only one file-level (Format 1) COLLATING SEQUENCE clause per file control entry. CaptureFileCollating counts the Format-1 clauses on the FileModel (FileLevelCollatingCount) and ResolveFileCollating rejects a count above one with COBOL1582. The clause is a COBOL-2002 addition (constructs.json file-collating-clause-2002), so 85 is the gate lane, not a behaviour lane.
